docs.summary: Material used during baking. Only the channels Photonic actually consumes are exposed: diffuse albedo (driving bounce colour), an optional emissive source, and per-channel UV transforms / texture references.
docs.remarks: Plain mutable POCO; populate fields after [`CreateMaterial`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.BakeScene~CreateMaterial).

docs.summary: Material name as registered on the scene.
Linear-space base colour. Used directly when no texture is bound.
Optional diffuse albedo texture. Sampled at the bake hit's [`DiffuseUVLayer`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.BakeMaterial~DiffuseUVLayer).
UV layer the diffuse texture is sampled from. Defaults to `"UV0"`.
Linear-space emissive colour added to direct lighting at any bake hit on this material.

Optional emissive texture (modulated by [`Emissive`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.BakeMaterial~Emissive)). Sampled at the texel's own `UV0`, not at [`DiffuseUVLayer`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.BakeMaterial~DiffuseUVLayer).
